QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] The Black Wings and the Puppeteer
QuestInfo.0: Listen to Roca for the mission's details.
QuestInfo.1: Roca told you about the Black Wings and the Puppeteer. The Black Wings are a cult who carry out the Black Mage's malicious will, with the apparent end goal of resurrecting him. The monsters on #bSuspicious Hill#k may lead to one of the Black Wings' officers, the Puppeteer.
QuestInfo.2: You found monsters that behaved as if their personalities had been altered. That's a known side effect of the Puppeteer's influence. Is he here?

default.0: Hmm? Did you not understand me? Please go to #bSuspicious Hill#k, and investigate the presence of Suspicious Monsters.\r\n
